indexes.indexdef: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX budgets_pkey ON n44_push_draft.budgets USING btree (owner_id, budget_key)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX contexts_pkey ON n44_push_draft.contexts USING btree (owner_id, workspace_id, device_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX deliveries_pkey ON n44_push_draft.deliveries USING btree (owner_id, workspace_id, device_id, event_id)
CREATE INDEX delivery_retention ON n44_push_draft.deliveries USING btree (owner_id, expires_at_ms)
CREATE INDEX retry_due ON n44_push_draft.deliveries USING btree (owner_id, next_at_ms) WHERE (state = 'retry'::text)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX endpoint_claims_owner_id_registration_id_key ON n44_push_draft.endpoint_claims USING btree (owner_id, registration_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX endpoint_claims_pkey ON n44_push_draft.endpoint_claims USING btree (fingerprint)
CREATE INDEX endpoint_owner ON n44_push_draft.endpoint_claims USING btree (owner_id)
CREATE INDEX events_due ON n44_push_draft.events USING btree (due_at_ms, owner_id, workspace_id, device_id, event_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX events_pkey ON n44_push_draft.events USING btree (owner_id, workspace_id, device_id, event_id)
CREATE INDEX ingress_expiry ON n44_push_draft.ingress_nonces USING btree (expires_at_ms)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ingress_nonces_pkey ON n44_push_draft.ingress_nonces USING btree (nonce)
CREATE INDEX ingress_scope ON n44_push_draft.ingress_nonces USING btree (scope)
CREATE INDEX ingress_kind ON n44_push_draft.ingress_rates USING btree (kind)
CREATE INDEX ingress_rate_expiry ON n44_push_draft.ingress_rates USING btree (expires_at_ms)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ingress_rates_pkey ON n44_push_draft.ingress_rates USING btree (key)
CREATE INDEX cleanup_due ON n44_push_draft.owner_clock USING btree (next_cleanup_ms, owner_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX owner_clock_pkey ON n44_push_draft.owner_clock USING btree (owner_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_active_context ON n44_push_draft.registrations USING btree (owner_id, workspace_id, device_id) WHERE (state = 'active'::text)
CREATE INDEX registration_expiry ON n44_push_draft.registrations USING btree (owner_id, expires_at_ms)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX registrations_pkey ON n44_push_draft.registrations USING btree (owner_id, registration_id)

triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER immutable_delivery BEFORE UPDATE ON n44_push_draft.deliveries FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION n44_push_draft.immutable_delivery()
triggers.name: immutable_delivery

triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER immutable_registration BEFORE UPDATE ON n44_push_draft.registrations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION n44_push_draft.immutable_registration()
triggers.name: immutable_registration
